name: suggest_card_change
title: Suggest a card change
description:
Stores new wording for one card's text field, for a person to accept in the builder. Changes nothing
live, so it also works on a live flow. `compare_card_text` shows the diff without storing it.

field.description: A text setting of the card, e.g. `instructions`. A refusal lists the card's.

new_text.description: The whole new text, at most 20,000 characters.

reason.description: Why, for the person who accepts it. At most 500 characters.
